Source: Conduct Disorder (CD) can pose serious concerns to parents, home and the society, meanwhile assessing this construct in clinical practice has been based on western concepts which limited the cultural factors implicated in CD.
Luganda: Enneeyisa embi (CD) esobole okuleetera abazadde, amaka n’ekitundu okweraliikirira, awo nno okwekaliriza embeera eno mu kisaawe ky’ekisawo kubadde kwesigama ku bitegeero okuva mu mawanga g’e Bulaaya ebitaatunuulira nsonga za buwangwa n’engeri gye zeeyolekera mu CD.
Yoruba: Àìṣedéédé ìwà (CD) lè jẹ́ ẹ̀dùn ọkàn ńlá fún àwọn òbí, ẹbí àti àwùjọ, àmọ́ ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò kíni yìí lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ ìṣèwòsàn jẹ́ ohun tí wọ́n gbé lórí ètè ilẹ̀ òkèèrè èyí tí ó kápá àṣà nínú CD kò.
Zulu: Conduct Disorder (CD) ingabangela ukukhathazeka okukhulu kubazali, amakhaya, kanye nomphakathi, okwamanje ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezemtholampilo kugxile kwimqondo ecashunwe yasentshonalanga enciphise izici zamasiko ezithintekayo kwi-CD.
Hausa: Rashin Ɗa’a (CD) na iya haifar da damuwa mai tsanani ga iyaye, gida da al'umma, yayin da kimanta wannan ginin a aikin asibiti ya dogara ne akan ra'ayoyin yammacin yamma wanda ya iyakance abubuwan al'adu da ke cikin CD.
Northern Sotho: Maitshwaro ao a Sego a Tlwaelega (CD) a ka baka tlhobaboroko go batswadi, ka gae le setšhabeng, le ge go le bjale go sekaseka seemo se ka mošomong wa tša kalafi go theilwe go dikgopolo tša bodikela tšeo di beetšwego thoko mabaka a setšo ao a amegago ka go CD.

Source: Convergent validity results showed a significant relationship between BPI-CD and Youth Deviant Behavior Variety Scale (r=.338, p<.01), while discriminant validity results revealed a non-significant relationship between (BPI-CD) and Social Skills Scale (r=.101, p>.05), thus showing a strong validity.

Hausa: Kayan aikin su, wanda kuma aka sani da Taƙaitaccen Fihirisar Ƙarfafawa don Rashin Halayya (BPI-CD), yana bincika ingantattun abubuwa 17 masu alaƙa da ɗabi'a.
Northern Sotho: Setlabelo sa bona, seo gape se tsebegago bjalo ka Dipalopalo ka Boripana ka ga Maitshwaro ao a Sego a Tlwaelega (BPI-CD), se lekola dintlha tše 17 tše di nepagetšego tša go amana le maitshwaro.
Amharic: አጠር ያለ የዝንባሌ መረጃ ጠቋሚ ለስነ ምግባር መዛባት (ዝ.መ.ጠ-ስ.መ) በመባል የሚታወቀው መሳሪያቸው፣ በትክክል ከባህሪ ጋር የተገናኙ 17 ነገሮችን ይፈትሻል፡፡

Source: Their tool showed that children with higher tendencies of CD were also more likely to have irregular behaviours.
Luganda: Ekikozseo kyabwe kyalaga nti abaana abatera okuba ne CD baalina emikisa mingi okuba n’emize egitali mirungi.
Yoruba: Ohun-èèlò náà fi hàn pé àwọn ọmọ tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n ní CD náà ni ó ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n ní àìṣedéẹ́dé nínú ìwà.
Zulu: Ithuluzi labo laveza ukuthi izingane ezinemvamisa ye-CD maningi amathuba okuba nokuziphatha okungajwayelekile.
Hausa: Kayan aikin su ya nuna cewa yaran da ke da ɗabi'un CD su ma sun fi samun halayen da ba su dace ba.
Northern Sotho: Setlabelo sa bona se laeditše gore bana bao ba felago ba eba le CD ya godingwana go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore ba ka ba le maitshwaro ao a sego a tlwaelega.
Amharic: መሳሪያቸው እንደሚያሳየው የስ.መ ዝንባሌ ያላቸው ልጆች የተዛቡ ባህሪያትን የማሳየት አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነው፡፡

Source: For example, those children were more likely to be aggressive to people and animals, violate rules, steal or destroy properties.
Luganda: Okugeza, waaliwo emikisa mingi abaana abo okuba ababaaluufu eri abantu n’ebisolo, okumenya amateeka, okubba oba okwonoona ebintu.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹ̀ẹrẹ, ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn ọmọ náà máa bínú sí àwọn ènìyàn, rú òfin, jalè tàbí ba ohun-ìní jẹ́.
Zulu: Isibonelo, lezo zingane maningi amathuba okuthi zibe nolaka kubantu kanye nasezilwaneni, ziphule imthetho, zebe noma zidicilele phansi izakhiwo.
Hausa: Misali, waɗannan yaran sun fi zama masu zagin mutane da dabbobi, keta ƙa'idodi, sata ko lalata kadarori.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, bana bao go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore ba ka šorofalela batho le diphoofolo, go tshela melawana, go utswa goba go senya dithoto.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ እንደዛ አይነት ልጆች በሰዎች እና በእንስሳት ላይ ጠበኛ የመሆን፣ህግጋትን የመጣስ፣የስርቆት፣ወይም ንብረትን የማውደም አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነው፡፡

Source: The researchers confirmed that indeed CD behaviour in African teens looks different compared to teens in western countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakakasa nti ddala enneeyisa ya CD mu batiini b’omu Afirika ya njawulo bw’ogeraageranya n’abatiini mu mawanga g’e Bulaaya.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà gbà pé lóòótọ́, ìwà CD nínú àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà yàtọ̀ sí ti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó wà ní apá ìwọ̀-oòrùn àgbáyé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi impela i-CD ukuziphatha kwentsha yase Afrika ibukeka ihlukile uma iqhathaniswa nentsha yamazwe asentshonalanga.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tabbatar da cewa haƙiƙa halayen CD a cikin matasan Afirka sun bambanta da matasa a ƙasashen yamma.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba tiišeditše gore ka nnete maitshwaro a CD ka go bafsa ba ka Afrika a bonagala a fapana ge a bapetšwa le a bafsa ba dinageng tša ka bodikela.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአፍሪካ ታዳጊዎች ላይ የሚታየው የስ.መ ባህሪ በምእራባውያን አገሮች ካሉ ታዳጊዎች ጋር ሲነጻጸር በእርግጥ ልዩ እንደሚመስል አረጋግጠዋል፡፡

Source: However, they cautioned against using their tool for diagnosis, saying instead that it is intended only to screen for possible CD.
Luganda: Wabula, baalabula obutakozesa kikozeso kyabwe okukebera, nga bagamba nti kyo kigendereddwamu okukebera obusobozi bw’okuba ng’omuntu alina CD.
Yoruba: Àmọ́, wọ́n kìlọ̀ lílo irin-iṣẹ́ wọn fún ṣíṣe ìdámọ̀-àìsàn, pé fún ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá CD nìkàn ni ó wà fún.
Zulu: Kepha, baxwayisile ngokusebenzisa ithuluzi labo ukuxilonga, bethi uma kuphela kuhloswe ukuhlola okuphathelene ne-CD.
Hausa: Duk da haka, sun yi gargaɗi game da yin amfani da kayan aikinsu don gano cutar, suna masu cewa a maimakon haka an yi niyya ne kawai don bincika yiwuwar CD.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, ba ile ba lemoša kgahlanong le go šomišwa setlabelo sa bona go phekola, ba bolela gore sebakeng seo setlabelo sa bona se ikemišeditše fela go lekola kgonagalo ya go ba gona ga CD.
Amharic: ሆኖም ግን መሳሪያቸው የታለመው ስ.መ መኖሩን ለማጣራት ብቻ በመሆኑ ለምርመራ እንዳይጠቀሙበት አስጠንቅቀዋል፡፡

Source: They also said their tool should not be used on adults in correctional institutions.
Luganda: Baayongerako ne bagamba nti ekikozeso kyabwe tekisaanye kukozesebwa ku bantu bakulu mu makomera.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ ṕ kí wọ́n má lo àwọn ohun-èèlò wọn fún àwọn tí wọ́n ti bàlágà ní àwọn gbàngàn ìbáwí.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi ithuluzi labo akumele lisetshenziswe kubantu abadala abasezikhungweni zokuhlumeleliswa kwezimilo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce bai kamata a yi amfani da kayan aikinsu ga manya a cibiyoyin gyara ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba boletše gore setlabelo sa bona ga se sa swanela go šomišwa go batho ba bagolo ka mafelong a tshokollo ya bagolegwa.
Amharic: መሳሪያቸውን በማረሚያ ተቋማት ውስጥ ባሉ አዋቂዎች ላይ መጠቀም እንደማይገባም ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers hoped the tool would be further validated across Africa, but said they were confident it works well to screen for CD in teens in the Nigerian context.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasuubira nti ekikozeso kijja kwongera okutuukanyizibwa okwetooloola Afirika, naye ne bagamba nti baali bakakasa nti kikola bulungi okukebera CD mu batiini mu ggwanga lya Nigeria.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà gbà á lérò pé kí irin-iṣẹ́ náà di dídánwò jákèjádò Áfíríkà, àmọ́ wọ́n ní ó dá àwọn ĺjú pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa fún àyẹ̀wò CD kára àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní ti Nàìjíríà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi banethemba ukuthi ithuluzi lizoqinisekiswa kwi-Afrika yonkana, kodwa basho ukuthi babenokuzithemba ukuthi lisebenza kahle ukuhlola i-CD kwintsha ngokwase Nigeria.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi fatan za a kara inganta kayan aikin a faɗin Afirka, amma sun ce suna da yaƙinin yana aiki da kyau wajen tantance CD a cikin matasa a yanayin Najeriya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba holofela gore setlabelo se se tla tiišetšwa go tšwela pele go ralala le Afrika, eupša ba bolela gore ba tshepha gore se šoma gabotse go lekola CD go bafsa ka seemong sa Nigeria.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ መሳሪያው በመላው አፍሪካ የበለጠ ተቀባይነት እያገኘ ይሄዳል የሚል ተስፋ አላቸው፤ ነገር ግን በናይጄሪያ አውድ በአስራዎቹ እድሜ ክልል ውስጥ ያሉ ወጣቶችን ለስ.መ ለማጣራት በሚገባ እንደሚሰራ እንተማመናለን ብለዋል፡፡
